title: design-package/v1 — designer-authored manifest (package.yaml at archive root)
description: HANDOFF-LEGO-PIPE-024-R1 contract, post-review (REVIEW-025-R1 union list / REVIEW-026 acceptance outcomes 1-15). Authored by Claude Design inside the exported archive from cut R2 onward; lives at the archive root as package.yaml and travels inside the verbatim bytes. A file of this schema found OUTSIDE a designer-exported tree (e.g. in docs/design/manifests/) is an error — reconstructions use design-package-overlay/v1. Identity is the cut key {design_package, revision, cut_state} (operator ruling 2026-09-19); the directory name is never identity.

design_package.x-note: REJECTED when it matches x-not-a-sheet-id or equals any sheets[].id in this manifest (025 R-19). Current package name from cut R2: DT-DESIGN (operator ruling 2026-09-18). Existing H-01 rows keep their name; no alias redirects H-01 pins to DT-DESIGN.

cut_state.x-note: Immutable component of identity, NOT lifecycle status (PR #12 reconciliation). Vocabulary is register data like thread names; current values: as-exported (default for a fresh designer cut), as-reviewed, as-committed. A second received state under the same package+revision gets a new durable cut_state; an existing key never changes.

path_base.x-note: All package_path references resolve against the archive root. No prefix-strip semantics exist for designer manifests — a manifest needing them fails (025 R-12; closes defect D-4 by contract).

governing_brief.x-note: The design brief governing this cut (today HANDOFF-LEGO-PIPE-014-R0). Validated against the register table's Number column and the row's operative state — never a substring search (025 R-17 / 026 R-02).

answers.x-note: Zero or more change requests / booklets this cut answers. Distinct relation from governing_brief; each resolved to an exact operative register row.

supersedes.x-note: Fully qualified predecessor (025 R-03 / 026 R-01): null ONLY when no predecessor exists in any package lineage. DT-DESIGN R2 supersedes {H-01, R1, <tree digest of the as-committed state>} — the rename does not break lineage.

maturity.x-note: Design-artifact maturity. Split from delivery coverage (025 R-22 / 026 R-03); neither field grants build authority — that comes only from a booklet's pin.

tier_coverage.x-note: How much of the governing brief's scope has been applied. Orthogonal to maturity: H-01 R1 is maturity=prototype with tier_coverage=tier-1.

mock_math.x-note: Required FIELD, not a pinned value (outcome 15 / 025 R-05). Preflight warns loudly while true; flipping to false requires a recorded operator ruling on that cut.

index.x-note: Pointer to index.json, which is package-internal navigation pending the cut-R2 DEC entry retiring DEC-028's single-source-of-status claim (025 R-24).

x-reference-types.source: design_source — opaque design-session provenance (.dc.html etc.), NEVER resolved against the package (025 R-01 P0: 11 of H-01-R1's 102 structured paths are these)
x-reference-types.spec: package_path — must resolve inside the package root

decisions.x-note: No ranges (025 R-13). ledger is a package_path to decisions.md; last_id and count are mechanically checked against the parsed ledger. The ledger is NEWEST-FIRST (verified 2026-09-19); comparison is by stable DEC-nnn id, never byte position, with exactly one permitted prior-row transition: a Status cell gaining a supersession reference naming a new, higher id (025 R-08 / 026 R-07).

fixtures.x-note: Identity of the fixture set that seeded this cut (023-R2 F5). Without it, weekly fixture reseeding dominates apparent drift (025 R-14 / 026 R-08).

known_defects.x-note: A defect NAMES A FAILURE — it is not a waiver (025 R-02 P0 / 026 R-05). Import authorization lives in a separate waiver record in the import record, never producer-authored. rule_id 'path-resolution' is reserved for path defects: it is the only rule preflight can itself verify, so only such defects can downgrade unresolved-path errors, and one whose paths all resolve is reported as stale (stale declaration = drift). All other rule_ids are declared runtime/DOM facts the tool reports without judging.

extensions.x-note: Namespaced producer metadata (026 §3.1); compatible additions land here without a schema revision.

x-field-authority.note: One owner per field; every assertion duplicated from index.json carries a mechanical agreement check or is not duplicated (outcome 4 / 025 R-13, R-24).
index.json: package-internal navigation only, pending the cut-R2 DEC entry

x-cut-key.rule: Uniqueness is enforced on the triple; a pin naming only package and revision is a validator error, never a silent choice. Operator ruling 2026-09-19 (register .24), superseding REVIEW-026 R-01's key.
